business.description: Shivalik Rasayan Limited is an integrated chemical manufacturer spanning agrochemicals and high-value active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). The Company has evolved from a legacy producer of technical-grade agrochemicals into a science-led chemical and life sciences manufacturer with a strong presence across agrochemical and pharmaceutical value chains, underpinned by its DSIR-recognized R&D centre and US FDA-approved facility.

outlook.statement: Strengthening R&D capabilities, expanding CDMO engagements and strengthening presence in regulated markets; focus on converting scientific capabilities into commercial opportunities and building a more resilient and valuable business.
Agrochemical plant at Dahej-III expected to generate approximately Rs. 200 Crores over the next two years.
Advancing API opportunities in Japan and South Korea; undertaking two additional API programs with a US-based company focused on NCE-1 and F2F products.

Transforming R&D into a profit-generating business through internal and customer-led projects; after achieving breakeven on R&D expenses last year, focus is now on increasing projects and generating greater commercial value.

Indian agrochemicals industry expected to witness stable growth of approximately 6-8% in 2026-27, supported by steady domestic demand, improving crop intensity, and expanding distribution reach; industry transitioning to volume-led growth phase with gradual improvement in operating conditions.

Global API market valued at over USD 159.3 billion in 2026, projected to surge toward USD 228.7 billion by 2033; India API manufacturing growth at center of global supply chain shift, driven by capacity expansion, policy support (PLI scheme), and regulatory experience.

Margin sensitivity persists due to crude oil and freight volatility, supply chain disruptions, and high reliance on Chinese KSMs; focus on product mix optimization and geographic diversification to mitigate concentration risk.
Dahej agrochemical plant expected to be fully utilized in next two years, targeting revenue of Rs. 200 Crores.
